summary: Marolyn E Sabala, 72, of Portland, OR, fell ~120 ft to her death from a cliff above the Green River at the Wade and Curtis River Campsite during the night or early morning after the private group launched from Gates of Lodore on July 18; body found Tuesday morning, fatality reported 11:41 a.m.; recovery team back at Gates of Lodore ~7:40 p.m.
location: Wade and Curtis River Campsite, Green River, Canyon of Lodore, Dinosaur National Monument
responding_agency: National Park Service Rangers; Moffat County Sheriff’s Office
notes: Earlier National Parks Traveler coverage (pre-ID) reported her age as 73; NPS release updated with identity gives 72; NPS says she climbed a slope west of the campsite during the night/early morning then fell; one party member rowed 2.5 mi upriver to report | Run 865: Basin Now fatal-fall article merged; parent-opened — same 2016-07-19 Marolyn Sabala Wade-and-Curtis 120-ft fall (id 2322); subagent's proposed 2022-08-16 date was a misread of the article's relative timestamp; adds Chief of Visitor Services Dan Johnson quote and local Basin Now coverage.
